---

maternal grandfather of Frances (Walter) Yonge

He was the father of father of Mary Emma, James Batten and Frances Charlotte Hilare Coulthard.

Deirdre Le Faye, Jane Austen’s Letters, 511, calls him James Battin Coulthard (1782-1856).

The Mrs Coulthard whom Jane Austen called (11 April 1805), 99, ‘a good-hearted, friendly woman’, was, Le Faye thinks, his stepmother Frances Barlow (1764-1829), who married his father Thomas Coulthard (1756-1811) in 1784.

Perhaps there was some connection with Hilare Barlow (d.1757), second wife of the first Earl Nelson, who subsequently (1837) married Austen’s nephew George Thomas Knight . [1841 census]
